title: %weightedAvg - weighted average of two arrays
purpose: Average values weighted by a parallel array of weights.
notes: Computes sum(value x weight) / sum(weight); here (90·3 + 80·2 + 70·1) / 6.
First argument is the values array, second is the weights array - order matters.
Weights summing to zero make the divisor zero, so the result is ~ (null).
Arrays of unequal length are truncated to the shorter one; here values[90,80,70] with weights[1,1] averages only the first two to 85.

avoid.why: swapping values and weights changes the result (here to ~2.083); the values array must come first
